|strategy=By Doug Taylor<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/gunganwarrior.html</ref>

It's like a taste of the Theed Palace set! The Gungans have shown up early!

Their primary purpose of these dog-faced lizards is to provide you with a common non-unique warrior for Sealed Deck, Booster draft, and Closed Environment (Episode I only) games, but these also make good surprise troops for any deck that wants to set up on the new (and powerful!) [[Naboo]] sites.

Deploy any of the five tempting [[Naboo]] battlegrounds, and drop some Jedi or Rebels. Wait until your opponent deploys troops there and battle them into running away. If you can herd them toward the Swamp, your Gungan Warriors can surprise them by dropping for free and it only takes two of them to get a battle destiny.

Just wait until we have electropoles to make them power 5 each...

Combos:

This is the one you want to use against your friend that hates Gungans. Make sure you speak in Gungan the whole time too, "Meesa deploy bombad Gungans here to give you a poundin' unto death..."

: much more Gungan trickery! Thesa got a grand army!
